claim: Physical-AI deployment is generating a market for repeatable simulation-based safety evaluation, with funding and product positioning centered on evidence before robots meet people.
verifiedFacts: SafeWorld offers scenario generation, interaction-risk prediction and evidence preservation.
AI Weekly reported Oct. 5 that SafeWorld raised more than $12M.
inference: Inferred: safety evidence is becoming a reusable product layer.
Inferred: the observe→infer→test→receipt pattern can transfer to physical-system demonstrations.
Unknown: retention and measured safety outcomes.
significance: Reinforces the physical-system proof line around Omni-Loom and suggests a bounded safety/evidence compiler.
assumptions: Simulation evidence must not be presented as safety certification.
knownLimitations: No contract values, retention or independent safety outcomes.
